meaningEn: Establishing an incontrovertible truth or baseline condition to validate a high-level academic conclusion ('given that / since indeed').
meaningId: Menetapkan kebenaran yang tidak terbantahkan atau kondisi dasar untuk memvalidasi kesimpulan akademis tingkat tinggi ('mengingat bahwa / karena memang').

notesEn.usage: High-level classical/literary connector used in formal argumentation and dissertation conclusions.
notesEn.nuance: Establishes a solemn, indisputable baseline before stating the core assertion.

notesId.formation: Kata Dasar Kata Kerja/Sifat + ~(으)ㄹ진대. Kata Benda: Kata Benda + 인진대.
notesId.usage: Kata penghubung sastra/klasik tingkat tinggi yang digunakan dalam argumentasi formal dan kesimpulan disertasi.
notesId.nuance: Menetapkan dasar yang khidmat dan tidak terbantahkan sebelum menyatakan penegasan inti.

examples.hangul: 학문의 본질이 진리 탐구에 있을진대 성실한 자세가 요구된다.
examples.romaja: hak-mun-ui bon-ji-ri jin-ri tam-gu-e is-seul-jin-dae seong-sil-han ja-se-ga yo-gu-doe-n-da.
examples.meaningEn: Given that the essence of academia lies in the pursuit of truth, a sincere attitude is required.
examples.meaningId: Mengingat hakikat ilmu pengetahuan terletak pada pencarian kebenaran, sikap yang jujur dan tekun sangat diperlukan.

examples.hangul: 시대의 흐름이 이러할진대 변화를 거부할 수는 없다.
examples.romaja: si-dae-ui heu-reum-i i-reo-hal-jin-dae byeon-hwa-reul geo-bu-hal su-neun eobs-da.
examples.meaningEn: Given that the trend of the era is such, we cannot refuse change.
examples.meaningId: Mengingat arus zaman memang demikian, kita tidak bisa menolak perubahan.

examples.hangul: 인간의 존엄성이 보편적 가치일진대 차별은 정당화될 수 없다.
examples.romaja: in-gan-ui jon-eom-seong-i bo-pyeon-jeok ga-chi-il-jin-dae cha-byeol-eun jeong-dang-hwa-doel su eobs-da.
examples.meaningEn: Since human dignity is a universal value, discrimination cannot be justified.
examples.meaningId: Mengingat martabat manusia adalah nilai universal, diskriminasi tidak dapat dibenarkan.

quiz.question: Which connector sets an incontrovertible premise in high academic prose ('given that / since indeed')?
quiz.explanationEn: ~(으)ㄹ진대 forms an unquestionable premise for formal argumentation.
quiz.explanationId: ~(으)ㄹ진대 membentuk premis yang tidak terbantahkan untuk argumentasi formal.

fillInTheBlank.sentenceEn: Given that the essence of academia lies in the pursuit of truth... -> 학문의 본질이 진리 탐구에 있___ 성실한 자세가 요구된다.
fillInTheBlank.sentenceHangul: 학문의 본질이 진리 탐구에 있___ 성실한 자세가 요구된다.
fillInTheBlank.hintId: Masukan kata penghubung premis akademis klasik.

constructionQuiz.promptEn: Translate to Korean: 'Given that the trend of the era is such, we cannot refuse change.'
constructionQuiz.promptId: Terjemahkan ke bahasa Korea: 'Mengingat arus zaman memang demikian, kita tidak bisa menolak perubahan.'
constructionQuiz.answer: 시대의 흐름이 이러할진대 변화를 거부할 수는 없다
constructionQuiz.answerReading: si-dae-ui heu-reum-i i-reo-hal-jin-dae byeon-hwa-reul geo-bu-hal su-neun eobs-da
acceptableVariants: 시대의 흐름이 이러할진대 변화를 거부할 수는 없습니다
constructionQuiz.hintEn: Use trend of era (시대의 흐름이) + like this premise (이러할진대) + change (변화를) + refuse (거부할) + cannot (수는 없다).
constructionQuiz.hintId: Gunakan arus zaman (시대의 흐름이) + premis demikian (이러할진대) + perubahan (변화를) + menolak (거부할) + tidak bisa (수는 없다).

meaningEn: Expressing unceasing, deep, heartfelt emotion or congratulations in formal settings.
meaningId: Mengekspresikan emosi atau ucapan selamat yang tulus, mendalam, dan tak henti-hentinya dalam situasi formal.

notesEn.formation: Verb Stem (typically emotion verbs like 감사하다, 축하하다, 기대하다) + ~아/어 마지않다.
notesEn.usage: Used in formal speeches, dedication notes, and high-level official congratulations.
notesEn.nuance: Carries the meaning 'does not cease doing X' (마지않다 = cease not).

notesId.formation: Kata Dasar Kata Kerja (biasanya kata kerja emosi seperti 감사하다, 축하하다, 기대하다) + ~아/어 마지않다.
notesId.usage: Digunakan dalam pidato formal, catatan persembahan, dan ucapan selamat resmi tingkat tinggi.
notesId.nuance: Mengandung arti 'tidak berhenti melakukan X' (마지않다 = tidak berhenti).

examples.meaningEn: I extend my unceasing and heartfelt congratulations on your boundless success.
examples.meaningId: Saya mengucapkan selamat yang tak henti-hentinya atas kemajuan Anda yang tak terbatas.

examples.hangul: 아낌없는 지원을 해주신 분들께 감사해 마지않습니다.
examples.romaja: a-kkim-eob-neun ji-won-eul hae-ju-sin bun-deul-kke gam-sa-hae ma-ji-ans-seum-ni-da.
examples.meaningEn: I am unceasingly grateful to those who provided unsparing support.
examples.meaningId: Saya tak henti-hentinya berterima kasih kepada mereka yang telah memberikan dukungan tanpa henti.

examples.hangul: 새로운 출발을 하는 당신의 앞날을 축복해 마지않습니다.
examples.romaja: sae-ro-wun chul-bal-eul ha-neun dang-sin-ui ap-nal-eul chuk-bok-hae ma-ji-ans-seum-ni-da.
examples.meaningEn: I unceasingly bless your future as you make this new start.
examples.meaningId: Saya tak henti-hentinya mendoakan masa depan Anda yang memulai langkah baru ini.

quiz.question: Which expression conveys unceasing, deep heartfelt emotion ('unceasingly thank / congratulate')?
quiz.explanationEn: ~아/어 마지않다 comes from 'not cease', expressing endless heartfelt emotion.
quiz.explanationId: ~아/어 마지않다 berasal dari kata 'tidak berhenti', mengekspresikan emosi tulus tanpa henti.

fillInTheBlank.sentenceEn: I extend my unceasing congratulations... -> 귀하의 무궁한 발전을 축하해 ___.
fillInTheBlank.hintId: Masukan pola yang berarti 'tak henti-hentinya melakukan'.

constructionQuiz.promptEn: Translate to Korean: 'I extend my unceasing congratulations on your endless success.'
constructionQuiz.promptId: Terjemahkan ke bahasa Korea: 'Saya mengucapkan selamat yang tak henti-hentinya atas kemajuan Anda yang tak terbatas.'
constructionQuiz.hintEn: Use your (귀하의) + endless success (무궁한 발전을) + congratulate unceasingly (축하해 마지않습니다).
constructionQuiz.hintId: Gunakan Anda (귀하의) + kemajuan tak terbatas (무궁한 발전을) + ucapan selamat tak henti (축하해 마지않습니다).

pattern: Verb Stem + ~을/ㄹ 여지가 없다 (Final Logical Elimination)
meaningEn: Definitively concluding that no further debate, doubt, or exception is possible.
meaningId: Menyimpulkan secara pasti bahwa tidak ada perdebatan, keraguan, atau pengecualian lebih lanjut yang memungkinkan.

notesEn.usage: Final capstone usage in technical, legal, and academic synthesis to state indisputable conclusions.

notesId.formation: Kata Dasar Kata Kerja + ~을/ㄹ 여지가 없다.
notesId.usage: Penggunaan penutup akhir dalam sintesis teknis, hukum, dan akademis untuk menyatakan kesimpulan yang tidak terbantahkan.

examples.hangul: 이 이론은 반박할 여지가 없을 정도로 완벽합니다.
examples.romaja: i i-ron-eun ban-bak-hal yeo-ji-ga eobs-eul jeong-do-ro wan-byeok-ham-ni-da.
examples.meaningEn: This theory is so perfect that there is no room for refutation.
examples.meaningId: Teori ini sangat sempurna hingga tidak ada celah untuk dibantah.

examples.meaningEn: It is a matter with legally no room for compromise.
examples.meaningId: Ini adalah masalah yang secara hukum tidak memiliki ruang untuk kompromi.

examples.hangul: 다시는 논란의 여지가 없도록 명확히 정리했습니다.
examples.romaja: da-si-neun non-ran-ui yeo-ji-ga eob-do-rok myeong-hwak-hi jeong-ri-haes-seum-ni-da.
examples.meaningEn: We sorted it out clearly so that there is no scope for controversy again.
examples.meaningId: Kami menyelesaikannya dengan jelas agar tidak ada celah untuk kontroversi lagi.

quiz.question: Which construction means 'so perfect that there is no room for refutation'?
quiz.explanationEn: ~을/ㄹ 여지가 없다 means no room or margin exists for refutation.
quiz.explanationId: ~을/ㄹ 여지가 없다 berarti tidak ada ruang atau celah untuk sanggahan.

fillInTheBlank.sentenceEn: This theory is so perfect that there is no room for refutation. -> 이 이론은 반박할 ___가 없을 정도로 완벽합니다.
fillInTheBlank.sentenceHangul: 이 이론은 반박할 ___가 없을 정도로 완벽합니다.
fillInTheBlank.hintId: Masukan kata benda terikat untuk celah/ruang.

constructionQuiz.promptEn: Translate to Korean: 'This theory is so perfect that there is no room for refutation.'
constructionQuiz.promptId: Terjemahkan ke bahasa Korea: 'Teori ini sangat sempurna hingga tidak ada celah untuk dibantah.'
constructionQuiz.answer: 이 이론은 반박할 여지가 없을 정도로 완벽합니다
constructionQuiz.answerReading: i i-ron-eun ban-bak-hal yeo-ji-ga eobs-eul jeong-do-ro wan-byeok-ham-ni-da
acceptableVariants: 이 이론은 반박할 여지가 없을 정도로 완벽해요
constructionQuiz.hintEn: Use this theory (이 이론은) + refute (반박할) + room (여지가) + doesn't exist to degree (없을 정도로) + perfect (완벽합니다).
constructionQuiz.hintId: Gunakan teori ini (이 이론은) + membantah (반박할) + ruang (여지가) + tidak ada sejauh (없을 정도로) + sempurna (완벽합니다).

pattern: Verb Stem + ~(으)ㄹ지언정 vs ~느니 차라리 (Final Concession vs Preference Review)
meaningEn: Distinguishing between resolute concession ('even if I die, I won't X') vs preference rejection ('rather than X, I'd rather Y').
meaningId: Membedakan antara konsesi tegas ('biarpun mati saya tidak akan X') vs penolakan preferensi ('daripada X lebih baik Y').

notesEn.formation: ~(으)ㄹ지언정 (focus on unwavering determination) vs ~느니 차라리 (focus on comparing two options and rejecting X).
notesEn.usage: Mastery of these two nuanced comparative connectors distinguishes high-level speakers.
notesEn.nuance: 지언정 = 'even under extreme pain, my will stands'; 느니 = 'option X is so bad I choose Y instead'.

notesId.formation: ~(으)ㄹ지언정 (fokus pada tekad yang tidak tergoyahkan) vs ~느니 차라리 (fokus pada membandingkan dua pilihan dan menolak X).
notesId.usage: Penguasaan kedua kata penghubung komparatif bernuansa ini membedakan penutur tingkat tinggi.
notesId.nuance: 지언정 = 'bahkan di bawah rasa sakit ekstrem, kehendak saya tetap berdiri'; 느니 = 'opsi X sangat buruk sehingga saya memilih Y'.

examples.meaningEn: Even if I fail, I will never give up.
examples.meaningId: Biarpun gagal, saya tidak akan pernah menyerah.

examples.hangul: 후회할 일을 하느니 차라리 시작을 안 하겠어요.
examples.romaja: hu-hoe-hal il-eul ha-neu-ni cha-ra-ri si-jag-eul an ha-ges-seo-yo.
examples.meaningEn: Rather than doing something I would regret, I would rather not start at all.
examples.meaningId: Daripada melakukan sesuatu yang akan saya sesali, lebih baik saya tidak memulainya sama sekali.

examples.meaningEn: Even if I receive criticism, I will not deceive my conscience.
examples.meaningId: Biarpun mendapat kritikan, saya tidak akan membohongi hati nurani saya.

quiz.question: Which sentence expresses unwavering resolve under potential hardship ('even if I fail...')?
quiz.explanationEn: ~(으)ㄹ지언정 emphasizes unyielding resolution despite prospective failure.
quiz.explanationId: ~(으)ㄹ지언정 menekankan tekad tak tergoyahkan meskipun menghadapi potensi kegagalan.

fillInTheBlank.sentenceEn: Even if I fail, I will never give up. -> 실패할___ 결코 포기하지 않겠습니다.

constructionQuiz.promptEn: Translate to Korean: 'Even if I fail, I will never give up.'
constructionQuiz.promptId: Terjemahkan ke bahasa Korea: 'Biarpun gagal, saya tidak akan pernah menyerah.'
constructionQuiz.hintEn: Use fail (실패할) + even if resolute (지언정) + never (결코) + give up won't (포기하지 않겠습니다).
constructionQuiz.hintId: Gunakan gagal (실패할) + biarpun teguh (지언정) + sama sekali tidak (결코) + menyerah (포기하지 않겠습니다).

meaningEn: Grand finale synthesis of complete humble dedication and single-focused fulfillment of duty.
meaningId: Sintesis puncak dari pengabdian penuh kerendahan hati dan pemenuhan tugas yang terfokus tunggal.

notesEn.formation: Vowel stem -> ~ㄹ 따름이다 / Consonant stem -> ~을 따름이다.
notesEn.usage: The ultimate concluding structure for advanced Korean language certification and formal mastery.
notesEn.nuance: Brings the entire curriculum to a dignified, polished close.

notesId.formation: Kata Dasar berakhiran Vokal -> ~ㄹ 따름이다 / Kata Dasar berakhiran Konsonan -> ~을 따름이다.
notesId.usage: Struktur penutup utama untuk sertifikasi bahasa Korea tingkat lanjut dan penguasaan formal.
notesId.nuance: Membawa seluruh kurikulum menuju penutup yang anggun dan dipoles sempurna.

examples.hangul: 모든 과정을 완수한 것에 감사할 따름입니다.
examples.romaja: mo-deun gwa-jeong-eul wan-su-han geos-e gam-sa-hal tta-reum-im-ni-da.
examples.meaningEn: I am merely grateful to have completed the entire curriculum.
examples.meaningId: Saya hanya sekadar bersyukur telah menyelesaikan seluruh rangkaian kursus ini.

examples.meaningEn: I will merely continue to strive forward with all my heart in the future.
examples.meaningId: Ke depannya saya hanya sekadar akan terus melangkah maju dengan sepenuh hati.

examples.hangul: 도움을 주신 모든 분께 진심으로 감사할 따름입니다.
examples.romaja: do-um-eul ju-sin mo-deun bun-kke jin-sim-eu-ro gam-sa-hal tta-reum-im-ni-da.
examples.meaningEn: I am merely sincerely thankful to everyone who provided help.
examples.meaningId: Saya hanya sekadar berterima kasih secara tulus kepada semua orang yang telah membantu.

quiz.question: Which ultimate structure completes 'I am merely grateful to have completed the entire curriculum'?
quiz.explanationEn: ~(으)ㄹ 따름이다 is the definitive formal structure for humble single-focused expression.
quiz.explanationId: ~(으)ㄹ 따름이다 adalah struktur formal definitif untuk ekspresi rendah hati yang terfokus.

fillInTheBlank.sentenceEn: I am merely grateful to have completed the entire curriculum. -> 모든 과정을 완수한 것에 감사할 ___입니다.
fillInTheBlank.hintEn: Insert bound noun of humble completion.
fillInTheBlank.hintId: Masukan kata benda terikat untuk penyelesaian rendah hati.

constructionQuiz.promptEn: Translate to Korean: 'I am merely grateful to have completed the entire curriculum.'
constructionQuiz.promptId: Terjemahkan ke bahasa Korea: 'Saya hanya sekadar bersyukur telah menyelesaikan seluruh rangkaian kursus ini.'
constructionQuiz.answer: 모든 과정을 완수한 것에 감사할 따름입니다
constructionQuiz.answerReading: mo-deun gwa-jeong-eul wan-su-han geos-e gam-sa-hal tta-reum-im-ni-da
acceptableVariants: 모든 과정을 완수한 것에 감사할 따름이에요
constructionQuiz.hintEn: Use all courses (모든 과정을) + completed fact (완수한 것에) + thankful modifier (감사할) + merely (따름입니다).
constructionQuiz.hintId: Gunakan semua kursus (모든 과정을) + fakta menyelesaikan (완수한 것에) + bersyukur (감사할) + sekadar (따름입니다).
